correctness.rationale: For fixed five-support S and seven-frequency zero set T, exact support (5,9) is feasible exactly when W[T,S] has nonzero kernel and neither a coordinate functional nor any outside Walsh row vanishes identically on that kernel; the row-space formulation is standard annihilator duality, and over C finitely many proper hyperplanes cannot cover a nonzero kernel. The bundled verifier constructs the affine group action and exhausts both five-support orbits and every seven-set T using exact rational row reduction after a sound modular full-rank filter. I independently replayed the census and reproduced orbit sizes 1680 and 2688, the 3248/160 deficient counts, the rank distributions, the 3184/64/160 obstruction split, and zero admissible cases.
risks: The classification is finite and specific to F_2^4, five time-support points, and seven prescribed Fourier zeros.
